$comment: Chrome DevTools Protocol frames a live app sent back, captured verbatim.
Source: an SDK 57.0.15 Expo Router app in Expo Go 57.0.9 on an iPhone 17 Pro simulator (iOS 26.5),
against `@expo/agent-cli start --go --port 8150`, on 2026-08-23. The `Runtime.evaluate` requests carried the
nonce fixed to `liveNonce` so the frames can be replayed.
These exist because the F21 bug was invisible to a unit test: `awaitPromise: true` was being sent and
the runtime was answering with the promise polyfill's internals, `{_A,_x,_y,_z}`, which is recorded

polyfillInternals.$comment: What `Runtime.evaluate("Promise.resolve(42)", {awaitPromise: true, returnByValue: true})` answered before this fix. No `subtype: "promise"`, so CDP never awaited anything.

pendingMarker.$comment: The wrapper's answer for any thenable: this run's marker, and nothing of the promise itself.
